fields.Name: T376 - User Menu About Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the dynamically-built user context menu (getUserMenuOptions/refreshMenuElements) and the aboutDialogService open path — distinct from the full settings/preferences page test.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Click the user avatar button in the TOP-RIGHT corner of the header to open the user menu. Verify the menu renders with a header showing your user name/email and a list of menu items. Click the 'About' item and confirm an About dialog opens showing MemberJunction information such as a version number. Seeing the user menu render and the About dialog open is success — you do NOT need to do anything inside the dialog. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The user avatar menu opens and displays a user identity header (name and/or email) plus menu items
An 'About' menu item is present and clickable
Clicking 'About' opens a dialog with MemberJunction/version information
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
